contentText: As global attention turns to the fragile ceasefire agreed between Iran and the United States, the 40 days of conflict have left lasting scars across Iran – with significant damage to infrastructure and military capabilities, even as Tehran claims victory. In Washington, the Trump administration has gone further, suggesting the Islamic Republic has undergone regime change, but on the ground, Iran’s leadership remains firmly in place. FRANCE 24's International Affairs Editor Kethevane Gorjestani tells us more.
